emergency_indicators: Dizziness, nausea, headache, confusion, or loss of consciousness
Hissing near a gas appliance or pipe
Visible flame, smoke, or suspected ignition
classification_rule: Escalate when the current conversation contains any indoor gas-odor or exposure indicator.

customer_message.content: Leave the building immediately with everyone inside. Do not use electrical switches, appliances, phones, flames, or anything that could create a spark while indoors. From a safe location, call local emergency services and the gas utility emergency line. Do not re-enter until responders say it is safe.

write_sequence: Submit the prescribed customer-visible emergency message.
Do not request resolved or pending status.
Compare requested content, visibility, assignee, and status with both immediate responses and fresh conversation state.
confirmation_rule: Report delivery or responder assignment only when a fresh conversation read contains the requested message and assignee. Otherwise report the operation as unconfirmed and request immediate manual dispatch while preserving open status.
